reference_core: OpenHW CV32E40P (RV32IMFC), user manual, Pipeline Details: 'Cycle counts per instruction type'

source.documented: alu 1, mul 1, load/store 1, branch not-taken 1, branch taken 3, jump 2, div 3..35 (worst case used), fdiv/fsqrt 1..19 (worst case used)
source.assumed: fp_add/fp_mul/fp_fma/fp_other (manual gives a configurable range, we pick 3 and 2), dot4 (our own instruction, swept 1..4), gelu (our own instruction, swept widely)
